text:
emily.marketing: quick sync on pricing page experiments — want final tier labels + runbook for calculator A/B. two simultaneous tests: tier naming and calculator UX.

sam.product: copy candidates: Option 1: Flex / Committed / Enterprise; Option 2: Starter / Growth / Enterprise. my lean = Flex set because it signals capacity without sounding limited.

nate.analytics: past tests: 'Starter' under-indexed on perceived capability (~0.6ppt). recommend we A/B Flex vs Starter on the page headline.

emily.marketing: noted. i'll draft microcopy for both label sets and create localized strings. also want the Committed tile to call out "Improved latency SLA" copy.

maya.cs: please add an FAQ anchor for "Committed capacity and latency" so CS can reference in playbook. also, when leads come from the calculator, include tier_selected in the payload. otherwise we lose experiment attribution.

sam.product: agreed — calculator variants: Simple estimator (single input) vs Slab (commit slider + tier preview). frontend will attach hidden fields to the sales form. payload example: {"lead_origin":"pricing_page","experiment":"nov_tier_test","variant":"slab","tier_selected":"committed"}.

ryan.growth: for webinar CTA under the calc: show an email capture interstitial (email + use-case select) before registration. retarget flow needs utm_experiment=tier_calc_nov. also add utm_campaign=pricing_launch_blog for external links.

nate.analytics: events to track: pricing_page_view, tier_label_click, calc_variant_shown, calc_submit, contact_sales_click, webinar_interstitial_submit. baseline conversion simple estimator = 3.9% -> target slab >= 4.5%. track 14d MQL rate, demo_sched_rate, ARR_cohort_90d.

emily.marketing: marketing will draft a short benchmark narrative for the launch blog: "Pricing shapes unit economics: a quick primer" and link to the calculator. will mockup CTAs in the doc.

sam.product: engineering note: watch for rounding edge cases in slab calc. previous bug when avg_tokens very small resulted in 0.00 for token price. filed ENG-1934 to guard divisions and format decimals to 4 places. P1.

maya.cs: sales routing ask: if tier_selected=committed and monthly_estimate >= 100k tokens, route to enterprise AE queue; otherwise route to SDR. helps prioritize high-intent demos.

ryan.growth: also request that contact-sales clicks include utm_experiment and variant so we can stitch sessions in GA. provide mapping to CRM fields.

nate.analytics: i'll build a dashboard tile with baseline and set an alert for delta >= 0.4ppt. need final event names + schema by EOD Thu.

emily.marketing: timeline: copy + hidden fields by Thu, ENG fixes Fri, QA Sat, flip A/B Mon 09:00 PT, run 14 days. anyone see issues?

sam.product: sounds good. i'll confirm event schema and ensure the sales form maps hidden fields to CRM.

deploy-bot: /deploy staging-pricing-page v2.1 — started by emily.marketing (CI #5012) :rocket:

emily.marketing: action items recap: 1) copy variations & localized strings (emily) 2) ENG ticket ENG-1934 for rounding + form fields (sam) 3) dashboard & baselines (nate) 4) CS FAQ anchor + playbook (maya) 5) webinar interstitial UX + utm params (ryan). will post experiment brief to #growth when we flip.
